about: Legitimate uses of avoid words for tools/lint-terms.mjs (npm run lint:terms). uiOnly: words matched only in UI strings although longer than two characters. docsToo: short words matched in docs prose too. allow: {file (glob), pattern (regex: the hit must lie inside its match) or line (substring of the line), term, reason, keep? (keep even when nothing matches now)}. noPairs: term ids skipped by the ja↔en pair check (their ja word is too generic for substring pairing, e.g. 本 in 2 本 and 日本語). aiDocsToo: avoid words also matched in the AI-instruction docs (docs/authoring-with-llms*), which otherwise use the spec's words and are not checked.
